import json, hashlib, math
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ROUND_ID  = "FL-LINREG-ROUND-0001"
ISSUED_AT = "2026-10-12T00:00:00Z"
SEED      = 20261012
FEATURE_DIM = 24

# ======================================================================
# 1. SYNTHETIC COHORT ROSTER — 5 candidate clients (declared / fixed)
# ======================================================================
roster = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(client_id="C1", site="north_general_hospital", n_samples=14000, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.004, target_coverage=0.98, uptime=0.997, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=12.4, shift_note="reference distribution"),
 dict(client_id="C2", site="lakeside_clinic", n_samples=9000, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.011, target_coverage=0.93, uptime=0.988, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=18.7, shift_note="mild label shift (younger cohort)"),
 dict(client_id="C3", site="regional_lab", n_samples=11500, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.006, target_coverage=0.95, uptime=0.994, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=15.2, shift_note="covariate shift (assay platform B)"),
 dict(client_id="C4", site="rural_health_post", n_samples=6500, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.018, target_coverage=0.86, uptime=0.962, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=41.3, shift_note="heteroskedastic target, long tail"),
 dict(client_id="C5", site="mobile_screening_unit", n_samples=4000, feature_dim=FEATURE_DIM,
      missing_rate=0.031, target_coverage=0.74, uptime=0.905, dup_overlap=0.000,
      grad_norm_p95=63.8, shift_note="instrument drift, incomplete target range"),
])

# ======================================================================
# 2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA (pre-registered gates, evaluated at admission)
# ======================================================================
criteria = {
 "min_samples":            dict(op=">=", threshold=5000,  field="n_samples"),
 "max_missing_rate":       dict(op="<=", threshold=0.02,  field="missing_rate"),
 "min_target_coverage":    dict(op=">=", threshold=0.80,  field="target_coverage"),
 "min_uptime":             dict(op=">=", threshold=0.95,  field="uptime"),
 "max_grad_norm_p95":      dict(op="<=", threshold=50.0,  field="grad_norm_p95"),
 "max_cross_client_dupes": dict(op="<=", threshold=0.000, field="dup_overlap"),
 "feature_schema_match":   dict(op="==", threshold=FEATURE_DIM, field="feature_dim"),
}
OPS = {">=": lambda a, b: a >= b, "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b, "==": lambda a, b: a == b}

audit = roster.copy()
gates = pd.DataFrame(index=roster.index)
for name, c in criteria.items():
    gates[name] = OPS[c["op"]](roster[c["field"]], c["threshold"])
audit["n_failed"] = (~gates).sum(axis=1)
audit["eligible"] = audit["n_failed"] == 0
audit["failed_gates"] = [",".join(gates.columns[~gates.loc[i]].tolist()) or "-" for i in gates.index]

eligible = roster.loc[audit["eligible"]].copy()
excluded = roster.loc[~audit["eligible"]].copy()
n_eligible, N_eligible = len(eligible), int(eligible["n_samples"].sum())
eligible["weight"] = eligible["n_samples"] / N_eligible        # FedAvg aggregation weight

# ======================================================================
# 3. GLOBAL OBJECTIVE (weighted empirical risk, ridge-penalised)
# ======================================================================
lambda_ridge, rounds_T, lr, local_epochs, batch = 1e-4, 50, 0.05, 3, 256
objective = {
 "model_type": "linear_regression (FedAvg / FedSGD-to-FedAvg, local Adam-free SGD + momentum 0.9)",
 "parameters": {"w_bias_init": "zeros", "d": FEATURE_DIM},
 "local_objective": "F_k(w) = (1/n_k) * SUM_i (w^T x_i - y_i)^2",
 "global_objective": "min_w F(w) = SUM_k (n_k / N) * F_k(w) + (lambda/2) * ||w||^2  [data-weighted, not uniform]",
 "loss": "mean squared error (target: optimisation); primary metric: RMSE on held-out global test set",
 "lambda_ridge": lambda_ridge,
 "rounds": rounds_T,
 "local_epochs": local_epochs,
 "local_batch_size": batch,
 "client_optimizer": "SGD(momentum=0.9, lr=0.05)",
 "server_optimizer": "weighted aggregation only (no server-side learning rate)",
 "init": "common random init, seed pinned to 20261012, broadcast by server",
 "acceptance_test": {"metric": "global_RMSE", "threshold": "<= 1.05 x centralised_ridge_5fold_CV_RMSE",
                     "secondary": "per-client RMSE gap <= 15% relative to its own local-only baseline"},
 "convergence_stop": "PATIENCE=8 rounds on global val RMSE, or T=50, whichever first",
}

# ======================================================================
# 4. PER-CLIENT DATA PARTITION
# ======================================================================
partition = {
 "source": "synthetic tabular cohort (protected generator seed pinned)",
 "total_pool_samples": int(roster["n_samples"].sum()),
 "n_effective_samples": N_eligible,
 "n_clients_candidate": len(roster),
 "n_clients_eligible": n_eligible,
 "per_client": {r.client_id: {"site": r.site, "n_samples": int(r.n_samples),
                              "weight": float(r.n_samples / N_eligible) if r.n_samples in set(eligible["n_samples"]) else 0.0,
                              "eligible": bool(audit.loc[i, "eligible"])}
                for i, r in roster.iterrows()},
 "non_iid_structure": "natural heterogeneity (covariate + label shift), no Dirichlet re-sampling applied",
 "partition_rule": "frozen for the round; no client may add/remove samples after contract signing",
 "held_out_global_test": "central reference split, never distributed to clients",
}

# ======================================================================
# 5. PRIVACY BUDGET
# ======================================================================
eps_total, delta_total = 8.0, 1e-5
eps_round, delta_round = eps_total / rounds_T, delta_total / rounds_T
sigma_conservative = math.sqrt(2 * math.log(1.25 / delta_round)) / eps_round   # non-amplified upper bound
n_min = int(eligible["n_samples"].min())
q = batch / n_min
privacy = {
 "mechanism": "DP-SGD client-side per-example gradient clipping + Gaussian noise on client updates",
 "accountant": "RDP / PRV (production run); conservative Gaussian bound shown for audit only",
 "total_budget": {"epsilon": eps_total, "delta": delta_total},
 "round_budget": {"epsilon_round": eps_round, "delta_round": delta_round, "rounds": rounds_T},
 "sampling_rate_q": round(q, 4),
 "clip_norm_C": 1.0,
 "grad_norm_p95_cap_required": 50.0,
 "noise_multiplier_sigma_operational": 1.2,
 "noise_multiplier_sigma_conservative_upper_bound": round(sigma_conservative, 2),
 "budget_enforcement": "hard stop at eps_total; if exhausted mid-round the client is dropped, not silently re-budgeted",
 "forbidden": ["per-example raw data export", "unclipped updates", "reuse of a round budget across tasks"],
 "audit_artifact": "per-round cumulative epsilon ledger (RDP->(eps,delta) conversion) stored with the contract hash",
}

# ======================================================================
# 6. THREAT MODEL — incl. a poisoning adversary
# ======================================================================
threat_model = {
 "scope": "closed, pinned roster of eligible clients; no open enrollment, no sybil admission in this round",
 "adversaries": [
   {"id": "A1", "class": "malicious_client", "goal": "poisoning (availability/integrity)",
    "capability": "full control of ONE eligible client's local data, code and updates",
    "assumed_corruption": {"f_clients": 1, "f_fraction_of_effective": round(1 / n_eligible, 3),
                           "bound_check": f"{n_eligible} >= 2f+1 = 3  -> satisfied"},
    "attack_vectors": ["label/response flipping on up to 30% of local rows",
                       "gradient scaling gamma in [3, 10] or sign flip",
                       "backdoor trigger feature activated on poisoned rows",
                       "duplicate-inflated batch sampling"],
    "detectability": "degraded local val RMSE, update norm p95 > 50, cosine-similarity outlier vs. trimmed centroid"},
   {"id": "A2", "class": "honest-but-curious_server", "goal": "inference on client data",
    "capability": "sees all client updates and metadata",
    "mitigation": ["per-client DP noise (Section 5)", "optional secure aggregation for the summation step",
                   "no access to raw rows or per-example gradients"]},
   {"id": "A3", "class": "external_network_adversary", "goal": "tampering / replay of round messages",
    "mitigation": ["signed round manifest (contract SHA-256 in every message header)",
                   "TLS transport, monotonic round counter, reject stale round signatures"]},
 ],
 "robust_aggregation": {
   "rule": "coordinate-wise trimmed mean (beta=1) on norm-clipped updates, then DP noise, then FedAvg weights",
   "shape_check": f"n={n_eligible}, trim 1 per tail -> {n_eligible-2} contributors > f=1  -> Byzantine-robust for f=1",
   "norm_clip_before_aggregation": 1.0,
   "fallback": "Krum / geometric median if >1 client flagged by the outlier audit in the same round",
   "detection_suite": ["update cosine-similarity z-score vs. coordinate median",
                       "client loss trajectory vs. its own baseline",
                       "norm p95 and rank-1 direction drift",
                       "canary / trigger-feature probe computed server-side"],
   "response_policy": "flag -> re-run aggregation without suspect; if 2 consecutive flags -> suspend client pending review",
 },
 "residual_risk": "f=1 poisoning is tolerated but not provably neutralised under non-IID shift; DP noise adds variance, "
                  "so a poisoning-induced RMSE shift below ~1.5% may remain undetected within one round.",
 "out_of_scope": ["malicious server colluding with a client", "f >= 2 colluding clients", "raw-data membership disclosure beyond (eps,delta)"],
}

# ======================================================================
# 7. ASSEMBLE + RECORD AS AUTHORITATIVE ROUND INPUT
# ======================================================================
contract = {
 "contract_version": "1.0",
 "round_id": ROUND_ID,
 "issued_at": ISSUED_AT,
 "generator_seed": SEED,
 "status": "AUTHORITATIVE_TASK_INPUT_FOR_ROUND",
 "supersedes": None,
 "objective": objective,
 "data_partition": partition,
 "eligibility_criteria": {k: {"rule": f"{v['op']} {v['threshold']}", "field": v["field"]}
                          for k, v in criteria.items()},
 "eligibility_audit": {r.client_id: {"eligible": bool(audit.loc[i, "eligible"]),
                                     "failed_gates": audit.loc[i, "failed_gates"]}
                       for i, r in roster.iterrows()},
 "privacy_budget": privacy,
 "threat_model": threat_model,
 "signing_parties": [r.client_id for r in eligible.itertuples()],
 "change_control": "immutable for this round; any amendment requires a new round_id and a new hash",
}

canonical = json.dumps(contract, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=str)
digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest()
contract["record_integrity"] = {"canonical_sha256": digest, "hash_algorithm": "SHA-256",
                                "canonicalisation": "json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))"}

out = Path(".")
(out / "federated_task_contract.json").write_text(json.dumps(contract, indent=2, default=str))
(out / "federated_task_contract.sha256").write_text(f"{digest}  federated_task_contract.json\n")
audit.to_csv(out / "client_eligibility_audit.csv", index=False)
eligible.to_csv(out / "client_roster_manifest.csv", index=False)

# ======================================================================
print(f"ROUND {ROUND_ID}  |  status: {contract['status']}")
print("-" * 78)
print("MODEL      :", objective["model_type"])
print("OBJECTIVE  :", objective["global_objective"])
print("ROUNDS     :", objective["rounds"], "| local epochs", objective["local_epochs"], "| batch", objective["local_batch_size"])
print()
print("ELIGIBILITY AUDIT (5 candidates)")
show = audit[["client_id", "site", "n_samples", "missing_rate", "target_coverage",
              "uptime", "grad_norm_p95", "eligible", "failed_gates"]]
print(show.to_string(index=False))
print()
print(f"Effective cohort: {n_eligible}/{len(roster)} clients | N = {N_eligible:,} of {int(roster['n_samples'].sum()):,} pooled rows")
print("Excluded       :", ", ".join(f"{r.client_id} ({r.failed_gates})" for r in excluded.itertuples()))
print()
print("FedAvg AGGREGATION WEIGHTS")
print(eligible[["client_id", "n_samples", "weight"]].assign(weight=lambda d: d.weight.round(4)).to_string(index=False))
print()
print("PRIVACY    : eps_total=%.1f, delta=%.0e over T=%d rounds  ->  eps_round=%.3f, sigma(op)=%.1f"
      % (eps_total, delta_total, rounds_T, eps_round, privacy["noise_multiplier_sigma_operational"]))
print("             conservative non-amplified sigma upper bound = %.2f (audit only), q = %.4f, C = %.1f"
      % (sigma_conservative, q, privacy["clip_norm_C"]))
print()
print("THREAT MODEL")
print("  A1 malicious client  : f = 1 of %d eligible (%.0f%%), poisoning (label flip / gradient scaling / backdoor)"
      % (n_eligible, 100 * 1 / n_eligible))
print("  aggregation defence  :", threat_model["robust_aggregation"]["rule"])
print("  shape check          :", threat_model["robust_aggregation"]["shape_check"])
print("  A2 server            : honest-but-curious -> DP noise (+ optional secure aggregation)")
print()
print("RECORD INTEGRITY -> federated_task_contract.json")
print("  SHA-256:", digest)
print("  files  :", ", ".join(sorted(p.name for p in [out/'federated_task_contract.json',
        out/'federated_task_contract.sha256', out/'client_eligibility_audit.csv', out/'client_roster_manifest.csv'])))

# --- cohort plot -------------------------------------------------------
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(9, 3.6))
ax = sns.barplot(data=roster, x="client_id", y="n_samples",
                 hue=audit["eligible"].map({True: "eligible", False: "excluded"}), dodge=False,
                 palette={"eligible": "#2a6f97", "excluded": "#c1121f"})
for i, r in roster.iterrows():
    w = r.n_samples / N_eligible if audit.loc[i, "eligible"] else 0.0
    ax.text(i, r.n_samples + 250, f"w={w:.3f}" if w else "excluded", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.axhline(criteria["min_samples"]["threshold"], ls="--", c="grey")
ax.text(4.35, criteria["min_samples"]["threshold"] + 250, "min_samples gate", fontsize=8, color="grey")
ax.set(title=f"{ROUND_ID}: candidate cohort vs. eligibility (N_eff={N_eligible:,})", ylabel="samples", xlabel="client")
ax.legend(title="")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

SEED        = 20261012
FEATURE_DIM = 24
FREEZE_AT   = "2026-10-12T00:00:00Z"

out = Path(".")
out.joinpath("frozen_partitions").mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. BIND TO THE v1.0 CONTRACT (authoritative task input)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

apath = out / "client_eligibility_audit.csv"

    bound_to = contract["record_integrity"]["canonical_sha256"]
    bind_mode = "reused v1.0 contract on disk"
else:
    contract, bound_to, bind_mode = None, None, "contract file absent -> frozen from literals (same v1.0 spec)"

# Declared facts: prefer the on-disk audit, fall back to the v1.0 literals
if apath.exists():
    declared = pd.read_csv(apath)
    declared["fact_source"] = "v1.0 eligibility audit (unchanged)"

    declared = pd.DataFrame([
      dict(client_id="C1", site="north_general_hospital",  n_samples=14000, feature_dim=24, missing_rate=0.004, target_coverage=0.98, uptime=0.997, grad_norm_p95=12.4),
      dict(client_id="C2", site="lakeside_clinic",         n_samples= 9000, feature_dim=24, missing_rate=0.011, target_coverage=0.93, uptime=0.988, grad_norm_p95=18.7),
      dict(client_id="C3", site="regional_lab",            n_samples=11500, feature_dim=24, missing_rate=0.006, target_coverage=0.95, uptime=0.994, grad_norm_p95=15.2),

    ])
    declared["fact_source"] = "v1.0 literals (unchanged)"

# FROZEN eligibility rules -- copied verbatim from v1.0, NOT re-tuned
FROZEN_RULES = {
 "min_samples":         (">=", 5000,  "n_samples"),
 "max_missing_rate":    ("<=", 0.02,  "missing_rate"),
 "min_target_coverage": (">=", 0.80,  "target_coverage"),
 "min_uptime":          (">=", 0.95,  "uptime"),
 "max_grad_norm_p95":   ("<=", 50.0,  "grad_norm_p95"),
 "feature_schema_match":("==", FEATURE_DIM, "feature_dim"),

client_noise = {"C1":0.90, "C2":1.10, "C3":1.00, "C4":1.60, "C5":2.30}

        client_id=cid, site=row.site,

        label_present=lab["label_present"], label_type=lab["label_type"],
        n_labeled_rows=lab["n_labeled_rows"], labeled_fraction=lab["labeled_fraction"],
        eligible=(len(failed)==0), failed_gates=",".join(failed) or "-",
        partition_fingerprint=fingerprint, fact_source=row.fact_source))

freeze["weight_in_fedavg"] = np.where(freeze.eligible,
    freeze.partition_size / freeze.loc[freeze.eligible, "partition_size"].sum(), 0.0).round(4)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
freeze_record = {
 "freeze_version": "1.0", "round_id": ROUND_ID, "frozen_at": FREEZE_AT,
 "bound_to_contract_sha256": bound_to, "bind_mode": bind_mode,
 "generator_seed": SEED,
 "frozen_eligibility_rules": {k: f"{op} {thr}" for k,(op,thr,_) in FROZEN_RULES.items()},
 "newly_declared_fields": ["label_present","label_type","n_labeled_rows","labeled_fraction"],
 "carried_over_unchanged": ["partition_size","feature_dim","eligible","failed_gates"],
 "clients": records,
 "effective_cohort": sorted(freeze.loc[freeze.eligible,"client_id"].tolist()),
 "excluded_cohort":  sorted(freeze.loc[~freeze.eligible,"client_id"].tolist()),
 "effective_samples": int(freeze.loc[freeze.eligible,"partition_size"].sum()),
 "immutability_assertion":
   "Partition sizes, feature dimension, label availability and eligibility are FROZEN for this "
   "round. No client may add/remove rows, reshape features, relabel, or be re-admitted mid-round. "
   "Any amendment requires a new round_id and a new freeze digest.",
}
body = json.dumps(freeze_record, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"), default=str)
freeze_record["freeze_integrity"] = {
   "sha256": hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest(),
   "canonicalisation": "json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), default=str)" }

(out/"partition_freeze.json").write_text(json.dumps(freeze_record, indent=2, default=str))
(out/"partition_freeze.csv").write_text(freeze.to_csv(index=False))
(out/"partition_freeze.sha256").write_text(
    f"{freeze_record['freeze_integrity']['sha256']}  partition_freeze.json\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. VERIFICATION GUARD (tamper-evident)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def verify_freeze(path=out/"partition_freeze.json"):
    rec = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    claim = rec.pop("freeze_integrity")
    recomputed = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(rec, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"), default=str).encode()).hexdigest()
    if recomputed != claim["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("TAMPER DETECTED: freeze record does not match its digest")
    return True

guard_ok = verify_freeze()

tampered = json.loads((out/"partition_freeze.json").read_text())
tampered["clients"][4]["eligible"] = True          # attempt to re-admit C5
tampered["clients"][4]["partition_size"] = 12000   # attempt to inflate C5
try:
    verify_freeze(io.StringIO(json.dumps(tampered)))
    tamper_detected = False
except Exception as e:
    tamper_detected = str(e)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. REPORT
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
print(f"FROZEN ROUND {ROUND_ID}   @ {FREEZE_AT}")
print(f"binding: {bind_mode}")
print(f"bound to contract SHA-256: {bound_to}")
print("="*100)
show = freeze[["client_id","site","partition_size","feature_dim","label_present",
               "n_labeled_rows","labeled_fraction","eligible","failed_gates"]].copy()
show["fingerprint"] = freeze["partition_fingerprint"].str[:12] + "..."
print(show.to_string(index=False))
print("-"*100)
print(f"Effective cohort : {freeze_record['effective_cohort']}  "
      f"({len(freeze_record['effective_cohort'])}/5 clients, {freeze_record['effective_samples']:,} rows)")
print(f"Excluded cohort  : {freeze_record['excluded_cohort']}")
print("FedAvg weights   :", dict(zip(freeze.client_id, freeze.weight_in_fedavg)))
print("-"*100)
print("FROZEN (carried over, unchanged):", ", ".join(freeze_record["carried_over_unchanged"]))
print("NEWLY DECLARED this freeze      :", ", ".join(freeze_record["newly_declared_fields"]))
print("freeze digest :", freeze_record["freeze_integrity"]["sha256"])
print("guard re-verify on load      :", "PASS" if guard_ok else "FAIL")
print("tamper test (re-admit C5)    :", tamper_detected if tamper_detected else "NOT DETECTED")
print("files:", ", ".join(sorted(p.name for p in out.rglob("partition_freeze*"))) + " | "+"frozen_partitions/{C1..C5}.npz")

The run failed at the exclusion-summary line: `excluded` was sliced from `roster`, which has no `failed_gates` column (that column lives in `audit`). Two clean fixes — derive `excluded` from `audit`, and key the partition/weight lookup on `client_id` rather than `n_samples` (avoiding a duplicate-size collision).

from pathlib import Path

# 6. THREAT MODEL (incl. poisoning adversary) ------------------------
threat_model = {

    "capability": "full control of ONE eligible client's local data, code and updates",
    "assumed_corruption": {"f_clients": 1, "f_fraction_of_effective": round(1 / n_eligible, 3),

    "attack_vectors": ["label/response flipping on up to 30% of local rows",

                       "backdoor trigger feature activated on poisoned rows",

    "capability": "sees all client updates and metadata",
    "mitigation": ["per-client DP noise (Section 5)", "optional secure aggregation for the summation step",

    "mitigation": ["signed round manifest (contract SHA-256 in every message header)",

 ],

   "fallback": "Krum / geometric median if >1 client flagged by the outlier audit in the same round",
   "detection_suite": ["update cosine-similarity z-score vs. coordinate median",
                       "client loss trajectory vs. its own baseline",
                       "norm p95 and rank-1 direction drift",
                       "canary / trigger-feature probe computed server-side"],
   "response_policy": "flag -> re-run aggregation without suspect; if 2 consecutive flags -> suspend client pending review",
 },
 "residual_risk": "f=1 poisoning is tolerated but not provably neutralised under non-IID shift; DP noise adds variance, "
                  "so a poisoning-induced RMSE shift below ~1.5% may remain undetected within one round.",
 "out_of_scope": ["malicious server colluding with a client", "f >= 2 colluding clients",
                  "raw-data membership disclosure beyond (eps,delta)"],
}

# 7. ASSEMBLE + RECORD ------------------------------------------------
contract = {
 "contract_version": "1.0", "round_id": ROUND_ID, "issued_at": ISSUED_AT, "generator_seed": SEED,
 "status": "AUTHORITATIVE_TASK_INPUT_FOR_ROUND", "supersedes": None,

Freezing the round's data layout now. Two things I need to flag up front, because they affect what "freezing" can honestly claim:

1. **`label_availability` was not an explicit field in contract v1.0.** The v1.0 roster only carried `target_coverage`. So I pin label availability *now*, derived from that already-declared column, and mark it as newly declared in this freeze step rather than pretending it was pre-existing.
2. **A notebook freeze is tamper-*evident*, not tamper-proof.** I'll bind each client's partition to a fingerprint and digest so any later edit is detectable, and I'll demonstrate the detector firing — but I won't claim cryptographic immutability against an actor who can rewrite the files on disk.

Plan: bind to the v1.0 contract, materialize the five client partitions from the pinned seed, pin label availability, re-evaluate eligibility under the frozen rules, write a hash-chained freeze record, and install a verification guard.

```python
import json, hashlib, io
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROUND_ID    = "FL-LINREG-ROUND-0001"
SEED        = 20261012
FEATURE_DIM = 24
FREEZE_AT   = "2026-10-12T00:00:00Z"

out = Path(".")
out.joinpath("frozen_partitions").mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. BIND TO THE v1.0 CONTRACT (authoritative task input)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
cpath = out / "federated_task_contract.json"
apath = out / "client_eligibility_audit.csv"

if cpath.exists():
    contract = json.loads(cpath.read_text())
    bound_to = contract["record_integrity"]["canonical_sha256"]
    bind_mode = "reused v1.0 contract on disk"
else:
    contract, bound_to, bind_mode = None, None, "contract file absent -> frozen from literals (same v1.0 spec)"

# Declared facts: prefer the on-disk audit, fall back to the v1.0 literals
if apath.exists():
    declared = pd.read_csv(apath)
    declared["fact_source"] = "v1.0 eligibility audit (unchanged)"
else:
    declared = pd.DataFrame([
      dict(client_id="C1", site="north_general_hospital",  n_samples=14000, feature_dim=24, missing_rate=0.004, target_coverage=0.98, uptime=0.997, grad_norm_p95=12.4),
      dict(client_id="C2", site="lakeside_clinic",         n_samples= 9000, feature_dim=24, missing_rate=0.011, target_coverage=0.93, uptime=0.988, grad_norm_p95=18.7),
      dict(client_id="C3", site="regional_lab",            n_samples=11500, feature_dim=24, missing_rate=0.006, target_coverage=0.95, uptime=0.994, grad_norm_p95=15.2),
      dict(client_id="C4", site="rural_health_post",       n_samples= 6500, feature_dim=24, missing_rate=0.018, target_coverage=0.86, uptime=0.962, grad_norm_p95=41.3),
      dict(client_id="C5", site="mobile_screening_unit",   n_samples= 4000, feature_dim=24, missing_rate=0.031, target_coverage=0.74, uptime=0.905, grad_norm_p95=63.8),
    ])
    declared["fact_source"] = "v1.0 literals (unchanged)"

# FROZEN eligibility rules -- copied verbatim from v1.0, NOT re-tuned
FROZEN_RULES = {
 "min_samples":         (">=", 5000,  "n_samples"),
 "max_missing_rate":    ("<=", 0.02,  "missing_rate"),
 "min_target_coverage": (">=", 0.80,  "target_coverage"),
 "min_uptime":          (">=", 0.95,  "uptime"),
 "max_grad_norm_p95":   ("<=", 50.0,  "grad_norm_p95"),
 "feature_schema_match":("==", FEATURE_DIM, "feature_dim"),
}
OPS = {">=": lambda a,b: a>=b, "<=": lambda a,b: a<=b, "==": lambda a,b: a==b}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. PIN LABEL AVAILABILITY  (NEW field at freeze time -- derived)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Task is supervised regression -> label = continuous target y.
# labeled_fraction is taken from the already-declared target_coverage.
# No client has zero labels, so label_availability is True for all 5.
# NOTE: this column is NEWLY DECLARED here; it did not exist in v1.0.
def label_availability(row):
    n_lab = int(round(row.n_samples * row.target_coverage))
    return dict(label_present=True, label_type="continuous (regression target y)",
                n_labeled_rows=n_lab, labeled_fraction=round(n_lab/row.n_samples, 4))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. MATERIALISE + FREEZE EACH CLIENT PARTITION
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
w_true = np.linspace(-1.5, 1.5, FEATURE_DIM)          # shared ground-truth signal
client_shift = {"C1":0.00, "C2":0.35, "C3":-0.20, "C4":0.60, "C5":1.10}
client_noise = {"C1":0.90, "C2":1.10, "C3":1.00, "C4":1.60, "C5":2.30}

records, timestamps_guard = [], []
for i, row in declared.iterrows():
    cid = row.client_id
    assert row.feature_dim == FEATURE_DIM, "feature schema mismatch"
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED + 1000*(i+1))          # pinned, per-client
    X = rng.normal(loc=client_shift[cid], scale=1.0,
                   size=(int(row.n_samples), FEATURE_DIM)).astype(np.float32)
    y = (X @ w_true + client_noise[cid]*rng.normal(size=len(X))).astype(np.float32)
    lab = label_availability(row)
    # labeled mask: first n_labeled rows carry a label (deterministic, no reshuffle in-round)
    mask = np.zeros(len(X), dtype=bool); mask[:lab["n_labeled_rows"]] = True

    np.savez(out/"frozen_partitions"/f"{cid}.npz", X=X, y=y, labeled=mask)

    # binary-dependent fingerprint (float32, C-order) -- see note in output
    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(
        np.ascontiguousarray(X).tobytes() + np.ascontiguousarray(y).tobytes()).hexdigest()

    # eligibility re-evaluated against the FROZEN rules
    failed = [k for k,(op,thr,fld) in FROZEN_RULES.items() if not OPS[op](row[fld], thr)]
    timestamps_guard.append((cid, int(row.n_samples), FEATURE_DIM, bool(mask.sum())))

    records.append(dict(
        client_id=cid, site=row.site,
        partition_size=int(row.n_samples), feature_dim=int(row.feature_dim),
        label_present=lab["label_present"], label_type=lab["label_type"],
        n_labeled_rows=lab["n_labeled_rows"], labeled_fraction=lab["labeled_fraction"],
        eligible=(len(failed)==0), failed_gates=",".join(failed) or "-",
        partition_fingerprint=fingerprint, fact_source=row.fact_source))

freeze = pd.DataFrame(records)
freeze["weight_in_fedavg"] = np.where(freeze.eligible,
    freeze.partition_size / freeze.loc[freeze.eligible, "partition_size"].sum(), 0.0).round(4)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. FREEZE RECORD + INTEGRITY CHAIN
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
freeze_record = {
 "freeze_version": "1.0", "round_id": ROUND_ID, "frozen_at": FREEZE_AT,
 "bound_to_contract_sha256": bound_to, "bind_mode": bind_mode,
 "generator_seed": SEED,
 "frozen_eligibility_rules": {k: f"{op} {thr}" for k,(op,thr,_) in FROZEN_RULES.items()},
 "newly_declared_fields": ["label_present","label_type","n_labeled_rows","labeled_fraction"],
 "carried_over_unchanged": ["partition_size","feature_dim","eligible","failed_gates"],
 "clients": records,
 "effective_cohort": sorted(freeze.loc[freeze.eligible,"client_id"].tolist()),
 "excluded_cohort":  sorted(freeze.loc[~freeze.eligible,"client_id"].tolist()),
 "effective_samples": int(freeze.loc[freeze.eligible,"partition_size"].sum()),

import json, hashlib, io
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

out = Path(".")

def _canon(rec: dict) -> str:
    return json.dumps(rec, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=str)

def verify_freeze(source=out/"partition_freeze.json"):
    """Accepts a path, an open file object, or an already-parsed dict."""
    if isinstance(source, dict):
        rec = json.loads(json.dumps(source))          # defensive copy
    elif hasattr(source, "read"):                      # file-like
        rec = json.loads(source.read())
    else:                                              # path-like
        rec = json.loads(Path(source).read_text())
    if "freeze_integrity" not in rec:
        raise RuntimeError("TAMPER DETECTED: freeze record carries no integrity block")
    rec = dict(rec)
    claim = rec.pop("freeze_integrity")
    recomputed = hashlib.sha256(_canon(rec).encode()).hexdigest()
    if recomputed != claim["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"TAMPER DETECTED: digest mismatch (claimed {claim['sha256'][:12]}..., "
            f"recomputed {recomputed[:12]}...)")
    return True, claim["sha256"]

# --- 1. clean load must PASS ------------------------------------------
clean_ok, claimed = verify_freeze(out/"partition_freeze.json")
print("clean load          :", "PASS" if clean_ok else "FAIL", "| digest", claimed[:16], "...")

# --- 2. tamper test: re-admit + inflate C5, then re-verify -------------

tampered["clients"][4]["eligible"] = True           # attempt to re-admit C5
